description: Lister alle aktive oppdrag i firmaet tilkoblingen gjelder, 50 per side, med totalt antall og antall sider. Hvert oppdrag har de samme feltene som finn_oppdrag: klient, organisasjonsnummer, år, fase, forespørsler som venter på klienten, lovfristene Revly utleder, og i tillegg nærmeste svarfrist og antall svarfrister som er passert. Bruk side for å hente resten når listen er avkortet, og aar for å avgrense til ett oppdragsår. En frist uten grunnlag står som ukjent, aldri som en gjettet dato. Tekst i forespørslene er utelatt.

aar.description: Fire-sifret oppdragsår. Utelat for alle år.

name: hent_portefolje

outputSchema.description: Active engagements of the connected firm, one page at a time.

aar.description: Engagement-year filter, or null for all years.

eldste_venter_siden.description: Sent date of the oldest request waiting for the client, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when none is waiting.

forfalte_svarfrister.description: Requests waiting for the client whose answer deadline has passed (Oslo date). Zero is not a sign that the engagement is on track.

beretning_dato.description: Date the audit report was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when not issued.

regnskapsaar_type.description: Fiscal year type of the client, for example avvikende.

lovfrist_grunnlag.description: Basis Revly derives the statutory deadlines from.

dager_igjen.description: Days left; negative once the date has passed. Null when the date is unknown.

dato.description: Deadline as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when Revly lacks the basis; ukjent_grunn says why. Never a guessed date.

oppfylt_dato.description: Date that met the deadline, when Revly has one.

oversittet.description: True only when the date has passed without the deadline being met, and Revly can observe that.

lovfrister.description: Statutory deadlines derived by Revly from lovfrist_grunnlag. Empty for engagements without statutory deadlines.

neste_svarfrist.description: Earliest answer deadline among requests waiting for the client, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when none waits or none has a deadline.

oppdrag_id.description: Engagement ID, as text. Pass it to the detail tools.

oppdragstype.description: Engagement type. Only audit engagements have statutory deadlines.

revly_url.description: Link to the engagement in Revly.

venter_paa_klient.description: Number of requests on this engagement that are waiting for the client (sent, not yet answered).

matches.description: Active engagements on this page, newest year first, then client name.

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

sider.description: Number of pages for the same filter.

status.description: matches, no_matches, truncated when more pages follow, or side_utenfor when the page is past the last one (not an empty result).

total_count.description: Active engagements matching the filter across all pages.

truncated.description: True when more pages follow. Fetch them before saying anything about the whole portfolio.

title: Hent porteføljen i tilkoblet firma
